articles.title: Why Countries Are Talking About Their Stored Diesel
articles.summary: Fuel saved for later is suddenly in the news. President Trump may ask Europe to release stored diesel while considering limits on American exports.

articles.title: Big Campaign Numbers Need a Closer Look
articles.summary: A huge number can leave out important details. PolitiFact checked President Trump’s campaign claims, including a $22 trillion investment figure and a record number of workers.

articles.title: Renee Good’s Family Brings Two Cases to Court
articles.summary: Two new lawsuits ask a court to examine a death in Minneapolis. Renee Good’s family filed the cases against the U.S. government and immigration officials; the claims have not been decided.
